comment: Fix these values BEFORE opening the full-run data. Any tolerance added later is exploratory.
tolerance_grid_provenance: Chosen after inspecting the local snapshot of 4,947 trials, which holds only rho=0.2, seed 0, orders 4-10. There the best excess per instance was 0.0008-0.0024; at tau=0.002 the best pair reached about 21% and the median pair 0%, so 0.002 separates almost nothing. No other ratio or seed informed the grid. Disclose this in the paper.
